soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles dark brown with a slightly paler base, antennae reddish brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head almost trapezoidal, widest in the posterior part of the head, the posterior margin rather broadly rounded; in lateral view the middle of the dorsal margin slightly raised and the ventral margin slightly projecting downwards; labrum ligulate, widest near the base, the apex of the transparent area rather pointed; mandibles stout with the apex curved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision, the fine teeth near the midpoint indistinct; postmentum rather narrow and elongate, the sides at the waist nearly parallel and slightly broader near the base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longest and about twice segment 2. Pronotum about as wide as the mesonotum and metanotum, about twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle, the lateral lobes narrow and rounded. Minor soldier: head pale reddish brown, mandibles deep reddish brown, antennae pale yellowish brown; head almost trapezoidal with the posterior margin almost broadly rounded; labrum ligulate with the dorsum slightly arched; mandibles rather slender and elongate, the tip slender and distinctly incurved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision; postmentum nearly rectangular; antennae with 16 segments, segment 3 longest; pronotum widest, the posterior margin distinctly concave in the middle.
